description: Starter multi-source plant disease dataset plan for PlantVillage, PlantDoc, Plant Pathology 2021, and Cassava Leaf Disease.

sources.name: plantvillage
sources.notes: Path is relative to the dataset root. Kaggle PlantVillage folders usually contain class directories such as Tomato___Late_blight.

sources.name: plantdoc
sources.notes: Path is relative to the dataset root. Roboflow/YOLO PlantDoc export with train/valid/test images and labels.

sources.name: plant_pathology_2021
sources.notes: Paths are relative to the dataset root. Apple field dataset. Multi-label rows are converted to composite labels for the current single-label trainer.

sources.name: cassava_leaf_disease
sources.notes: Paths are relative to the dataset root. Kaggle cassava challenge labels are numeric; this map makes them human-readable.

sources.name: plant_leaf_disease
sources.notes: ImageFolder-style plant leaf disease dataset without augmentation.

sources.name: plant_leaf_disease_augmented
candidate_paths: New Plant Diseases Dataset(Augmented)/New Plant Diseases Dataset(Augmented)/train
sources.notes: ImageFolder-style augmented plant disease dataset. Keep source metadata so augmented results can be evaluated separately.
